metadata.case_name: HO TZE HO v. CHUI CHUNG WAH AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: He was detected to have a closed fracture of left tibia and fibula at metaphysical-diaphyseal region
source: He was detected to have a closed fracture of left tibia and fibula at metaphysical-diaphyseal region with multiple adhesions on both knees, left leg, left forefoot, lip and chin.

manifestations.description: The Plaintiff had transient loss of consciousness after the accident.
The only complaint is itchiness and numbness over the left foot scar.
Overall length of the lower limb is longer than the right by 1 cm.
Left ankle planer flexion is slightly less than the right side by 5 to 10 degrees.

treatments_received: Debridement of the leg and foot wounds (16th and 21st August 2003)
Close reduction of fracture and long leg dynacast (21 August 2003)

losses.description: The injuries left him with a number of conspicuous, thickened, hyperpigmented and hypertropic scans on his left foot.
Dr. Wong assessed the loss of earning capacity for general labour jobs to be 3%.
